name: Illusory Dragon

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Create a Huge tangible shadow dragon in a visible empty space; it is immune to damage and conditions. Enemies seeing its appearance save Wisdom or drop held objects and become Frightened; repeat at turn end only without line of sight to the dragon. Bonus Action moves it 60 feet and exhales a 60-foot Cone: Intelligence save against 6d6 of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, or Poison (choose when casting), half on success. Study/Investigation against spell DC reveals the illusion and grants Advantage against its breath and to end its fear.
